name: Osami Ookami
source:
Black Cat Dorm President.
The mysterious new student president in one of the dorms for everyday humans.
Osamu was suggested for the post by the director himself just after transferring to the academy for his last year in high school.
He has a suspicious smile on day and night, talks ambiguously and appears out of thin air in the most surprising moments just to disappear the same way.
And although they just met, he is showing signs of being really interested in Sheryl.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1881950/Reimei_no_Gakuen__OtomeVisual_Novel/]Steam[/url]]
